struct CAN_InitTypeDef

CAN init structure definition.

Public Members

uint8_t CAN_AutoReTxEn

Specify Whether the auto re-transmission function is enable. This parameter can be a value of ENABLE or DISABLE.

uint8_t CAN_RxFifoEn

Specify Whether the RX FIFO function is enable. This parameter can be a value of ENABLE or DISABLE.

uint8_t CAN_RxDmaEn

Specify Whether the RX DMA function is enable. This parameter can be a value of ENABLE or DISABLE.

uint8_t CAN_TestModeSel

Specify the test mode of CAN. This parameter can be a value of CANTestModeSel_TypeDef

uint16_t CAN_ErrorWarnThd

Specify error counter warning threshold. This parameter can be set from 0x1 to 0x1ff.

CAN_BIT_TIMING_TYPE_TypeDef CAN_BitTiming

Specify the bit timing of CAN. CAN_BIT_TIMING_TYPE_TypeDef
